historical_references.reference: Ghanasyaam was a renowned Hindu scholar and philosopher of the 12th century AD. He was born in the southern Indian state of Karnataka and studied under the great philosopher Shankara. Ghanasyaam is best known for his contributions to the field of Advaita Vedanta, particularly his commentary on the Vedanta Sutras known as the Bhashya or Tattvabodhini commentary.
